summary:
Implementation plan for RB DIALER:
- Complete removal of dancing 3D cartoon characters from onboarding in favor of polished 3D still feature illustrations (VoIP, Video, Chat)
- Replacement of internal Hardware ID with a clean End-to-End Encrypted Verified badge in the Account screen
- App-wide rebranding to RB DIALER with custom 3D adaptive launcher icon and launcher label
- Smooth RB logo splash opening reveal and animated in-app update notification modal with live download simulation
- WhatsApp/Telegram-grade clean UI headers, uncluttered glassmorphism styling, and verified Z-index video call controls overlay
